text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Hassan and French President Jacques Chirac to discuss the Middle East peace process on Wednesday, France stresses its support of Jordan.
- Jordanian-Palestinian higher committee headed by Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti and Abu Mazen from the Palestinian side is expected to convene before the end of the month in Gaza.
- Prime Minister Kabariti to leave on Thursday to join the king on a European tour that covers Britain, Ireland and Germany.
- Jordan holds Arab contacts to release Jordanian prisoners held in Kuwaiti jails.
- King Hussein visits Bonn next Monday.
- A French commitment to support Jordan and its economic reforms.
